as_told.title: Immaculate Constellation revealed at congressional hearings

tellings.quote: these individuals have revealed the name of an active and highly secretive DoD unacknowledged special access program, or USAP.

plain: In late 2024, hearings in Congress brought out the name of a secret military program said to study UFOs, called Immaculate Constellation. At the House Oversight Committee hearing on UFOs on 13 November 2024, the journalist Michael Shellenberger said in his statement that his sources "have revealed the name of an active and highly secretive DoD unacknowledged special access program, or USAP." DoD is the Defense Department, and a USAP is a secret program whose very existence the government does not admit. Michels speaks of it on the show in December 2024, describing hearings "both in the Congress and then this week in the Senate" and "this revelation of this program." In January 2025 he raises it again with a Navy scientist, calling it simply a top secret program and saying nothing of a Senate hearing. The official hearing record is the firsthand source here, and Michels passes it on as the host. If the program is real, the military has been running a hidden effort on UFOs that Congress did not know about.
